title: Tumble and the Huffy-Puffy Balloon
moral: When big feelings come, slow down, use your senses, and let friends help.
description: Tumble the baby elephant has the biggest, reddest balloon at the Clover Wood Fair, until a gusty wind blows it into the tall oak tree! Can Pip, Hazel and Nana Hoot help Tumble with his huffy-puffy feeling? Learn to see, hear, smell, taste and touch in this funny animated story about managing big feelings, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Today was the Clover Wood Fair! And Tumble had the biggest, roundest, reddest balloon EVER!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Look, Pip! It's red, like a strawberry! I love it so, so much!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! It's a balloon-a-loony-licious!
Hee-hee! Tumble held the string tight with his trunk. Bob, bob, bob went the balloon.
Then... WHOOOSH! A big, gusty wind came blowing across the fair!
The string slipped right out of Tumble's trunk. Up, up, UP went the balloon... and it got stuck in the tall oak tree!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! HONK! My balloon! Come back!
Tumble's ears flapped. Stomp, stomp, stomp! His cap flew right off his head! Tumble had a great big, huffy-puffy feeling.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Don't worry, Tumble! I'll jump and get it!
Pip jumped. BOING! Not high enough. Pip jumped again. BOING! Still not high enough!
So Pip took a super big run and... BONK! Right into the tree! And a little acorn fell, plop, on his head. Hee-hee!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: It's no use! My feeling is too BIG! HONK!

narration.text: Next sense! Tumble flapped his big ears and listened. Shhh...
Ribbit, ribbit! went a frog. Quack, quack! went a duck. And then... tee-hee-hee!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! It's me, Hazel! Are you playing a game?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Yes! I can HEAR with my ears. My big, floppy ears!
Then Hazel led everyone to the pie stall. Mmm! Nana Hoot bought a warm apple pie.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: The next sense is taste. We taste with our tongue. Sweet, and sour, and... zzzzz.
Uh-oh! Nana fell asleep right in the middle of talking! Hee-hee!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Mmm! I can taste it with my tongue! It's sweet and yummy!

popups.sub: we FEEL with hands and skin

narration.text: Next sense! Touch! Tumble touched the soft, squishy moss. Ooh, so soft!
Then he touched Hazel's prickles. BOING! They all stood straight up!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Pokey, pokey!
What do we touch and feel with, friends?
Our hands and our skin! Yes! And Tumble's huffy-puffy feeling got smaller, and smaller, and smaller.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: The last sense is smell! We smell with our noses. And your nose is super-duper long, Tumble!
Tumble took a slow, calm breath. Sniff, sniff... a fluffy dandelion! But the fluff tickled his trunk... AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO!
WHOOSH! The giant sneeze blew the balloon right out of the tree! Down, down, down it floated...
...and Tumble caught the string. Hooray!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! I feel calm now. And I have my balloon!
Let's remember! How many senses do we have? Count them on your fingers!
Five! See, hear, smell, taste and touch! Hooray!
And what do we hear with, friends?
Our ears! Just like Tumble's big, floppy ears!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! What clever friends you are!
Later, Hazel dropped her cupcake. Splat! Her lip went wibble-wobble.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Don't worry, Hazel. When I had a big feeling, my friends helped me. Let's play the Five Senses Game!
Then Tumble let Hazel hold his big red balloon. Tee-hee-hee! went Hazel.
And everybody did a happy, wiggly fair dance. Hooray!
